settings.title: Prescription support for nicotine dependence
settings.text:
Most people make two or three attempts before it sticks. That is normal, not a failure. What changes the odds is medical support: the right therapy, the right dose, and someone checking in.

Quity pairs a consultation with an Australian-registered doctor with TGA-approved nicotine therapy, dispensed by a registered pharmacy and shipped to your door in plain packaging. No waiting room, no subscription, no cost to apply.

settings.title: Support that makes quitting convenient, discreet and compliant
Smoking and vaping rates in Australia
settings.body: Around one in ten Australian adults still smokes daily, and most of them say they want to stop. Vaping has grown fastest among people under 30, many of whom never smoked cigarettes at all. Both carry dependence on the same drug, and both respond to the same clinical approach: a measured dose, a taper, and a plan.
settings.image_alt: Clinician in a bright clinical setting

settings.title: Why willpower alone has poor odds
settings.body: Unassisted quit attempts succeed a small fraction of the time. Combining behavioural support with nicotine replacement therapy roughly doubles the chance of stopping for good — which is why every Quity plan pairs medication with a scheduled check-in rather than sending you off with a box.

settings.title: The first fortnight is the hardest
settings.body: Cravings peak between days three and ten, then fall sharply. Knowing that in advance is half the battle; having the right dose on hand for the peak is the other half. Your doctor reviews the plan at week two and again at week four.

settings.question: What’s the first step to begin?
settings.answer: Create an account and complete the online assessment. It takes about five minutes and costs nothing. A registered Australian doctor reviews it and emails you the outcome, usually within 24 hours.

settings.question: Can I submit an existing prescription?
settings.answer: Yes. Upload a valid e-script with its QR code or token number. Our pharmacist verifies it, then dispenses and ships from our partner pharmacy.

settings.question: What if I’m not approved for a prescription?
settings.answer: You pay nothing. If a doctor decides nicotine therapy is not appropriate for you, they will explain why and suggest alternatives.

settings.question: How quickly can I receive my prescription?
settings.answer: Most assessments are reviewed within 24 hours. Approved orders leave the pharmacy the same business day, with express delivery reaching most of Australia the next.

settings.question: Who determines if I qualify for nicotine therapy?
settings.answer: An AHPRA-registered Australian doctor. They review your smoking and medical history against TGA prescribing guidelines before writing anything.

settings.question: What are the shipping costs?
settings.answer: Free on orders over $150. Below that, standard shipping is a flat rate and express is available at checkout. Everything ships in plain packaging.

settings.question: What is your returns and refunds policy?
settings.answer: Prescription medicines cannot be returned once dispensed, under Australian law. If an order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact support and we will replace it.

settings.question: Do you accept prescriptions with a QR code?
settings.answer: Yes. QR-coded e-scripts and token numbers are both accepted through the upload form.

settings.question: What is the price range for prescribed products?
settings.answer: Most patients spend between $25 and $60 a week on therapy, depending on the plan. There is no subscription and no consultation fee.

settings.question: Am I eligible if I currently vape?
settings.answer: Yes. Nicotine dependence is treated the same whether it comes from cigarettes or vaping. Tell the doctor what you currently use and how often.
